title: Runtime index design (runtime-v2/indexes)
builder: runtime-v2/index-builder.cjs — node runtime-v2/index-builder.cjs (full rebuild 80.2s; pass5 build peak RSS 700MB)

passes.pass1: id -> subjectIdx int meta (mcq_by_id.json 20MB), by_chapter/by_topic/by_difficulty/by_year/by_exam id lists (insertion order = rowid order), per-subject active counts (mcq_by_subject.json), manifest.json {sourceFiles:{subject:{bytes,lines}}, rows:872621, maxCreatedAt:2026-08-05T12:46:30}
passes.pass2: search postings: question+explanation tokens, lowercased unicode [\p{L}\p{N}]+ >=4 chars, bucketed by first char (a-z0-9 + 'other' = 37 files), sorted keys for prefix matching
passes.pass3: options grouped per subject -> options/<subject>.json (243 files); meta stored as plain ints — decode must use Array.isArray fallback (fix applied: previously 3.49M options orphaned)
passes.pass4: recent.json: { ids: [872621 ids in rowid order], rp: [recent-order permutation] } (23MB)
passes.pass5: qhash.idx (75MB) + concept.idx — removal candidates: no runtime reader exists

boundedness.note: all reads are streaming (ChunkWriter/writeJsonStreamed flush in 20k-item slices); pass3 peak memory kept low via per-subject flush

determinism.note: indexes are deterministic across rebuilds given identical exports; integrity verified with order-independent per-row sha256 hashes (27/27 PASS — see phase38_integrity.json)

runtime_consumption.search: buckets cached LRU by bytes (32MB cap)
runtime_consumption.options: loaded per subject on demand (options/<subject>.json) or from LRU part
